description.value: Chickasta is a Vancouver fusion restaurant built around the pairing of chicken and pasta, with a wide-ranging menu that also includes burgers, wraps, burritos, poutines, and rice bowls drawing on South Asian and international flavours. The Kingsway location is one of two Vancouver outlets and offers online ordering, making it a convenient stop for a hot meal mid-ride. Menu highlights include tandoori chicken rice bowls, chorizo poutine, and housemade mango lassi.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 26m; wall_loops (3 spaces, covered) at 97m; stands (4 spaces) at 97m. Total: 9 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the Kingsway location at Unit 5, 1022 Kingsway, Vancouver with phone +1 (604) 428-1300. OSM tags the cuisine as 'indian' but the website positions Chickasta as a chicken-pasta fusion restaurant with diverse street food items; some South Asian-inspired dishes (tandoori, mango lassi, paneer) exist but the dominant identity is fusion, not Indian — flagged as a concern. No bike parking, washroom, refill, or Wi-Fi information appears anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM cuisine tag is 'indian' but the website describes Chickasta primarily as a chicken-pasta fusion restaurant with street food and international items; Indian-inspired dishes are present but secondary — the cuisine tag is inaccurate.
OSM has no phone number; phone +1 (604) 428-1300 sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a live website, online ordering, and confirmed Kingsway address. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a hot meal.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes Tandoori Paneer Salad (vegetarian) and Cauliflower Bites (vegetarian); paneer and plant-based items are explicitly listed
